firm_data.firm_description: Einbinder Dunn Dimitri & Bayer LLP is a business law firm advising business owners on the legal aspects of creating, developing and sustaining a successful business. They offer excellent yet affordable legal services in a wide array of practice areas.
notable_facts: The firm has a proven track record of delivering for its clients for more than 30 years.
The firm represents mid-size and larger companies, as well as small businesses and entrepreneurs, in the New York metropolitan area and nationally.

email.subject: AI for Einbinder Dunn Dimitri & Bayer LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Michael,

You've been advising business owners on the legal side of building successful companies since 1990, and that foundation matters. Franchising, litigation, and business law demand precision and client trust that BigLaw playbooks often miss.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
